module_title: Gallantry Awards - Design Architecture, Ribbon Patterns, and Advanced Bar Systems
introduction: Tailored for specialized defense examinations (NDA, CDS, AFCAT) and SSC CGL Tier-2, this advanced level deep dives into the intricate physics of the medals, their designer, ribbon color layouts, and the operational 'Bar' system for repeat gallantry.

core_concepts.title: Metallurgy and Design of the Param Vir Chakra
core_concepts.description: The PVC medal is surprisingly made of plain Bronze. It is a circular medal (1.375-inch diameter). On the obverse, it features four replicas of 'Indra's Vajra' (the mythical weapon made from Sage Dadhichi's bones symbolizing supreme sacrifice) surrounding the state emblem in the center. On the reverse, 'Param Vir Chakra' is embossed in both Hindi and English with two lotus flowers.

core_concepts.title: Design Architecture of the Ashoka Chakra
core_concepts.description: Unlike the bronze PVC, the Ashoka Chakra is made of Gold-Gild (gold-plated silver). It features a replica of Ashoka's Chakra (the wheel of law) in the center, surrounded by a lotus wreath.

core_concepts.title: The Unique 'Bar to a Gallantry Award' System
core_concepts.description: If an individual who has already received a gallantry award performs another act of bravery that would make them eligible for the award again, they do not receive a second physical medal. Instead, they are awarded a 'Bar' attached to the ribbon. For every bar awarded, a miniature replica of the 'Vajra' (for PVC) or 'Chakra' (for Ashoka Chakra) is added to the ribbon bar when worn alone.

core_concepts.title: The Story of the Designer: Savitri Khanolkar
core_concepts.description: The Param Vir Chakra was designed by a foreign-born lady named Savitri Khanolkar. Born Eva Yvonne Linda Maday-de-Maros in Switzerland, she married an Indian Army officer (Vikram Khanolkar), converted to Hinduism, deeply studied Indian mythology, and designed the highest military medal.

important_entities.name: The PVC Ribbon
important_entities.significance: The Param Vir Chakra is uniquely suspended by a very simple, unadorned purple-colored ribbon.

important_entities.name: The Maha Vir Chakra Ribbon
important_entities.significance: The MVC medal is made of standard silver and features a striking half-white, half-orange ribbon layout.

important_entities.name: Peacetime Ribbon Code (Green Base)
important_entities.significance: All three peacetime gallantry ribbons are green in color, but differentiated by central orange vertical lines: Ashoka Chakra has 1 orange line, Kirti Chakra has 2 orange lines, and Shaurya Chakra has 3 orange lines.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: A major cognitive trap! Students assume that because the Param Vir Chakra is the highest honor, it must be made of Gold. This is false. The PVC is made of Bronze, while the peacetime Ashoka Chakra is made of Gold-Gild.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: To identify the ribbon by its stripes: 1 vertical orange line = Ashoka; 2 lines = Kirti; 3 lines = Shaurya.

exam_strategy_tips: Defense papers often ask detailed conceptual questions on iconography (e.g., 'Which mythical weapon is embossed on the PVC?'). Ensure you recall 'Indra's Vajra' and its connection to Sage Dadhichi for absolute accuracy.
